name: yanshu-workbench
description: Extensible research workflows coordinated across local files, pluggable executors, and deterministic validation.

interface.shortDescription: Installable research workflows for writing, figures, and publication.
interface.longDescription: YanShu is an extensible research-workflow plugin with nine directly invokable sub-skills: $idea-discovery, $paper-drafting, $citation-audit, $paper-reconstruction, $scientific-figure, $experimental-plotting, $peer-review, $revision-planning, and $revision-audit. Every Skill resolves the same configuration and Prompt source as the website, then executes directly in the current Codex or CLI task without opening a local page, internal JSON file, or extra chat. Optional external writing and experimental-plotting skills use one explicit consent receipt and exact sub-skill allowlists; YanShu never installs an entire third-party skill repository.
defaultPrompt: Use $paper-reconstruction to reconstruct this manuscript directory in the current task.
Use $idea-discovery to find evidence-backed research ideas in this workspace.
Use $paper-drafting to draft a paper from completed experiments.
Use $citation-audit to verify and strengthen citations in this manuscript.
Use $scientific-figure to create one publication-ready research figure.
Use $experimental-plotting to create a reproducible publication plot from experimental data.
Use $peer-review to review this manuscript independently.
Use $revision-planning to organize these reviews into a revision plan.
Use $revision-audit to verify this response and revised manuscript.
